# Pssst

> Pssst is a tiny native macOS app that lives next to the MacBook notch and shows which of your Grok Bot agents need you, with a short message preview so you can tell if it matters before you switch apps. Tagline: your bot wants something.

Pssst is an independent app built by Dawid Woźniak and Sature. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Grok Bot. Price: $7 one-time purchase for Mac, no subscription.

## Product

- [Pssst landing page](https://pssst.dawidw.pl/): features, notch demo and FAQ
- [Privacy](https://pssst.dawidw.pl/privacy.html): what the app reads and why no data leaves your Mac
- [Terms](https://pssst.dawidw.pl/terms.html): terms of use
- [Changelog](https://pssst.dawidw.pl/changelog/): what is new in each version
